verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ صُوفَرُ ٱلنَّعْمَاتِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.web: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

verses.ar: «أَكَثْرَةُ ٱلْكَلَامِ لَا يُجَاوَبُ، أَمْ رَجُلٌ مِهْذَارٌ يَتَبَرَّرُ؟
verses.kjv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.web: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

verses.ar: أَصَلَفُكَ يُفْحِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ، أَمْ تَلِخُّ وَلَيْسَ مَنْ يُخْزِيكَ؟
verses.kjv: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.web: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

verses.ar: إِذْ تَقُولُ: تَعْلِيمِي زَكِيٌّ، وَأَنَا بَارٌّ فِي عَيْنَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast said, My doctrine [is] pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.web: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ يَا لَيْتَ ٱللهَ يَتَكَلَّمُ وَيَفْتَحُ شَفَتَيْهِ مَعَكَ،
verses.kjv: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.web: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

verses.ar: وَيُعْلِنُ لَكَ خَفِيَّاتِ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ! إِنَّهَا مُضَاعَفَةُ ٱلْفَهْمِ، فَتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ ٱللهَ يُغْرِمُكَ بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ إِثْمِكَ.
verses.kjv: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that [they are] double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee [less] than thine iniquity [deserveth].
verses.web: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

verses.ar: «أَإِلَى عُمْقِ ٱللهِ تَتَّصِلُ، أَمْ إِلَى نِهَايَةِ ٱلْقَدِيرِ تَنْتَهِي؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.web: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

verses.ar: هُوَ أَعْلَى مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، فَمَاذَا عَسَاكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ؟ أَعْمَقُ مِنَ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ، فَمَاذَا تَدْرِي؟
verses.kjv: [It is] as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.web: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

verses.ar: أَطْوَلُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ طُولُهُ، وَأَعْرَضُ مِنَ ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: The measure thereof [is] longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.web: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

verses.ar: إِنْ بَطَشَ أَوْ أَغْلَقَ أَوْ جَمَّعَ، فَمَنْ يَرُدُّهُ؟
verses.kjv: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.web: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ يَعْلَمُ أُنَاسَ ٱلسُّوءِ، وَيُبْصِرُ ٱلْإِثْمَ، فَهَلْ لَا يَنْتَبِهُ؟
verses.kjv: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider [it]?
verses.web: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلرَّجُلُ فَفَارِغٌ عَدِيمُ ٱلْفَهْمِ، وَكَجَحْشِ ٱلْفَرَا يُولَدُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ.
verses.kjv: For vain man would be wise, though man be born [like] a wild ass’s colt.
verses.web: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

verses.ar: «إِنْ أَعْدَدْتَ أَنْتَ قَلْبَكَ، وَبَسَطْتَ إِلَيْهِ يَدَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
verses.web: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَبْعَدْتَ ٱلْإِثْمَ ٱلَّذِي فِي يَدِكَ، وَلَا يَسْكُنُ ٱلظُّلْمُ فِي خَيْمَتِكَ،
verses.kjv: If iniquity [be] in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.web: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ تَرْفَعُ وَجْهَكَ بِلَا عَيْبٍ، وَتَكُونُ ثَابِتًا وَلَا تَخَافُ.
verses.kjv: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.web: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَنْسَى ٱلْمَشَقَّةَ. كَمِيَاهٍ عَبَرَتْ تَذْكُرُهَا.
verses.kjv: Because thou shalt forget [thy] misery, [and] remember [it] as waters [that] pass away:
verses.web: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

verses.ar: وَفَوْقَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ يَقُومُ حَظُّكَ. ٱلظَّلَامُ يَتَحَوَّلُ صَبَاحًا.
verses.kjv: And [thine] age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.web: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

verses.ar: وَتَطْمَئِنُّ لِأَنَّهُ يُوجَدُ رَجَاءٌ. تَتَجَسَّسُ حَوْلَكَ وَتَضْطَجِعُ آمِنًا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig [about thee, and] thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.web: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

verses.ar: وَتَرْبِضُ وَلَيْسَ مَنْ يُزْعِجُ، وَيَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ كَثِيرُونَ.
verses.kjv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make [thee] afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.web: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

verses.ar: أَمَّا عُيُونُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَتَتْلَفُ، وَمَنَاصُهُمْ يَبِيدُ، وَرَجَاؤُهُمْ تَسْلِيمُ ٱلنَّفْسِ».
verses.kjv: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope [shall be as] the giving up of the ghost.
verses.web: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
